days.routeJp: Arrive Tokyo (HND / NRT) → APA Hotel Shinjuku Kabukicho & Omoide Yokocho
days.routeEn: Check in beside JR Shinjuku Station, pick up IC card & enjoy Tokyo Metropolitan Gov't Bldg night views
days.hotel: APA Hotel & Resort Shinjuku Kabukicho Tower
legs: Flight to Tokyo (¥45,000 est.)
Haneda Monorail / N'EX / Yamanote to Shinjuku (¥1,500)
days.tip: Add Apple Wallet Suica/PASMO before landing. Stay at APA Kabukicho Tower (public bath on top floor) steps from Shinjuku Bus & JR West Exit.

timeSlots.desc: Airport train/monorail transfer to JR Shinjuku Station (Suica/PASMO)
Check in at APA Hotel Shinjuku Kabukicho Tower & unpack
Evening view at Tokyo Metropolitan Gov't Bldg South Deck & yakitori dinner

days.routeJp: Tokyo ↔ Lake Kawaguchiko Winter Day Trip (Oishi Park, Ropeway & Hoto Fudo)
days.routeEn: Timed on Monday before Japan's Tue Feb 23 Emperor's Birthday holiday for clearer snow views & smaller crowds
days.hotel: APA Hotel & Resort Shinjuku Kabukicho Tower
legs: Shinjuku ↔ Otsuki (JR Fuji Excursion Ltd Exp ¥4,400 RT)
Otsuki ↔ Kawaguchiko (Fujikyuko Line ¥3,860 RT • Non-JR)
Kawaguchiko Sightseeing Red Line Bus 1-Day Pass (¥1,500 • Non-JR)
days.tip: Reserve JR Fuji Excursion seats 1 month ahead (sold out fast); backup option is Keio Highway Bus from Busta Shinjuku (~¥4,400 RT). Lunch at Hoto Fudo (Tabelog ★3.57).

timeSlots.desc: Direct JR Fuji Excursion Limited Express to Kawaguchiko
Red Line Bus to Oishi Park northern shore & Mt. Fuji Panoramic Ropeway
Pumpkin miso Hoto noodles at Hoto Fudo (Tabelog ★3.57)
Evening Fuji Excursion return train to Shinjuku APA Hotel

days.routeJp: Tokyo Highlights (Holiday): Asakusa Senso-ji, Ueno Plum Blossoms & Shibuya Sky
days.routeEn: Catch late-Feb plum blossoms & early kanzakura in Ueno Park before Shibuya Sky sunset skyline
days.hotel: APA Hotel & Resort Shinjuku Kabukicho Tower
legs: Tokyo Metro 24-Hour Pass / IC Rides (¥900)
days.tip: Book Shibuya Sky 16:40 sunset slot 4 weeks prior (~¥2,500). Try Unagi Irokawa / Hatsuogawa in Asakusa (Tabelog ★3.72).

timeSlots.desc: Asakusa Senso-ji Kaminarimon, Nakamise Street & early Sumida riverside blooms
Asakusa Unagi lunch (★3.72), then Ueno Toshogu plum trees & kanzakura
Sunset panorama from Shibuya Sky 46F rooftop over Tokyo & Mt. Fuji twilight

days.routeJp: Tokyo → Atami Plum Garden & Peak Kawazu Sakura Festival → Shizuoka
days.routeEn: Winter meets full spring! 460 plum trees at Atami Baien + 850 vivid pink Kawazu-zakura lining Kawazu River
legs: Tokyo → Atami → Kawazu → Atami → Shizuoka (JR Odoriko + Ito Line ¥7,400 JR / ¥3,420 Izukyu Non-JR)
days.tip: Ship main luggage from Shinjuku APA to Kyoto APA via Yamato (~¥2,200 included in fun/logistics) and stash small packs in Atami Station coin lockers! Lunch at Atami Ginza Osakana Shokudo (Tabelog ★3.50).

timeSlots.desc: Drop bags at Atami coin lockers after morning Tokaido train; bus to Atami Baien
Atami Plum Garden late-Feb blooms & seafood bowl lunch at Atami Ginza Osakana Shokudo (★3.50)
JR Odoriko/Izukyu down to Kawazu Cherry Blossom Festival (4km vibrant pink river tunnel)
JR Tokaido Line back via Atami to Shizuoka & check in APA Hotel Shizuoka-eki Kita

days.routeJp: Shizuoka ↔ Starbucks EXPASA Fujikawa (Morning Mt. Fuji 絶景) & Miho-no-Matsubara
days.routeEn: 07:15 AM clear sky Mt. Fuji coffee overlooking Fuji River, afternoon Nihondaira Ropeway & Shizuoka dark-broth oden
legs: Shizuoka ↔ JR Fujikawa ↔ Shimizu (JR Tokaido Line ¥1,440)
JR Fujikawa Stn → EXPASA Fujikawa SA Taxi (¥1,200 morning 絶景) + Bus Return (¥200)
Shizuoka–Nihondaira–Miho Bus & Kunozan Ropeway Shuttle (¥1,200 • Non-JR)
days.tip: Because Fujikawa SA is on the Tomei Expressway, staying in Shizuoka cuts morning travel to just 28 min by JR! Take an early 5-min taxi uphill (~¥1,200) to Starbucks EXPASA Fujikawa before 08:30 while Mt. Fuji is cloud-free; take public Yamanashi Bus from 'Fujikawa Rakuza Mae' back down. Dinner at Aoba Oden Alley (Tabelog ★3.56).

timeSlots.desc: JR train to Fujikawa + 5-min uphill taxi for crisp 07:30 AM coffee & Mt. Fuji view at Starbucks terrace (local bus/25-min downhill walk back)
Nihondaira Yume Terrace, Kunozan Ropeway & UNESCO Miho Pine Grove overlooking Suruga Bay
Shizuoka dark-broth oden skewers & grilled black hanpen at Aoba Oden Alley (★3.56)

days.routeJp: Shizuoka → Kyoto (Hikari Shinkansen) & Dusk Fushimi Inari Shrine
days.routeEn: Morning Shinkansen straight into Kyoto Station, check in at APA Kyoto Ekimae & sunset vermilion torii gates
legs: Shizuoka → Kyoto (Tokaido Shinkansen Hikari ¥10,450)
Kyoto ↔ Inari (JR Nara Line ¥300 RT)
days.tip: Sit on right-hand E seats from Shizuoka for Hamamatsu lake & Ibuki views. Your shipped luggage awaits at APA Hotel Kyoto Ekimae (3-min walk from JR Kyoto Central Exit). Dinner at Katsukura Kyoto Station Cube (Tabelog ★3.64).

timeSlots.desc: Direct Tokaido Shinkansen Hikari from Shizuoka to JR Kyoto Station
Drop bags / retrieve Yamato luggage at APA Kyoto Ekimae & explore Nishikikouji / Station
Golden-hour Fushimi Inari Taisha climb, then crispy tonkatsu at Katsukura (★3.64)

days.routeJp: Kyoto Weekend Day 1 (Sat): Kiyomizu-dera, Kitano Tenmangu Plum Grove & Gion
days.routeEn: Beat weekend crowds at 07:30 Kiyomizu-dera, feast at Nishiki Market & enjoy peak late-Feb 1,500 plum blossoms at Kitano Tenmangu
legs: Kyoto City Subway & Bus 1-Day Pass (¥1,100 • Non-JR)
days.tip: Kitano Tenmangu's Baien Plum Garden peaks around Feb 25–early March with over 1,500 red & white blossoms! Try Kyoto obanzai & matcha treats at Nishiki Market (Tabelog ★3.75).

timeSlots.desc: Early taxi/bus up to Kiyomizu-dera -> Sannenzaka -> Ninenzaka -> Yasaka Shrine
Kyoto Obanzai tasting & fresh yuba skewers at 400-year-old Nishiki Market
Subway/bus to Kitano Tenmangu Shrine's blooming 1,500-tree Plum Blossom Grove
Lantern-lit Gion Hanamikoji stroll & Pontocho alley dinner (duck ramen ★3.70)

days.routeJp: Kyoto Weekend Day 2 (Sun): Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, Yudofu & Kinkaku-ji
days.routeEn: Beat Sunday crowds at 07:30 Arashiyama Bamboo Grove & Tenryu-ji, silken yudofu lunch & afternoon Kinkaku-ji
legs: Kyoto ↔ Saga-Arashiyama (JR Sagano Line ¥480)
Arashiyama → Kinkaku-ji → Kyoto Station (Randen Tram & City Bus ¥700 • Non-JR)
days.tip: Savor bamboo-basket Yudofu kaiseki at Sagano / Junsei (Tabelog ★3.68) and cap the afternoon with Nakamura Tokichi Uji Matcha parfait in Kyoto Station (★3.75).

timeSlots.desc: JR Sagano Line 16 min to Saga-Arashiyama: Bamboo Grove, Tenryu-ji Garden & Togetsukyo
Simmered Kyoto Yudofu tofu lunch in Arashiyama (Tabelog ★3.68)
Scenic Randen tram + bus to Kinkaku-ji Golden Pavilion & return to Kyoto Stn for Nakamura Tokichi matcha (★3.75)

days.routeJp: Kyoto → Kanazawa (Thunderbird + Hokuriku Shinkansen) & Kenrokuen Snow Ropes
days.routeEn: Travel north to APA's birthplace city! Winter snow crabs at Omicho Market, Kenrokuen Yukitsuri & Higashi Chaya
legs: Kyoto → Tsuruga (JR Thunderbird) → Kanazawa (Hokuriku Shinkansen • Tourist One-Way ¥6,500; Std ¥9,460)
Kanazawa Loop Bus 1-Day Pass (¥800 • Non-JR)
days.tip: Use JR West's foreign-visitor Hokuriku One-Way Ticket (¥6,500 vs ¥9,460 standard!). APA Hotel Kanazawa Ekimae (just outside East Exit) has natural onsen baths. Lunch at Omicho Market (Ikiiki-tei ★3.64) & dinner nodoguro/oden (Itaru/Kuroyuri ★3.71).

timeSlots.desc: Thunderbird Limited Express to Tsuruga + easy cross-platform Hokuriku Shinkansen to Kanazawa
Drop bags at APA Hotel Kanazawa Ekimae, then winter snow crab & nodoguro kaisen-don at Omicho Market (★3.64)
Walk Kenrokuen Garden under iconic winter yukitsuri pine ropes + Kanazawa Castle & Higashi Chaya gold-leaf soft serve (★3.55)

days.routeJp: Kanazawa → UNESCO Shirakawa-go Snow Village → Hida Takayama & A5 Hida Beef
days.routeEn: Reserve Nohi Highway Bus through snow-blanketed thatched roofs & overnight in a central Hida Takayama hot-spring station hotel
days.hotel: Wat Hotel & Spa Hida Takayama (Closest APA-Tier Onsen Hotel)
legs: Kanazawa Station → Shirakawa-go (Nohi/Hokutetsu Bus ¥2,600 • Non-JR)
Shirakawa-go → Takayama Nohi Bus Center (¥2,800 • Non-JR)
days.tip: Reserve Kanazawa→Shirakawa-go→Takayama highway bus 1 month early via JapanBusOnline / Willer (coin lockers available at Shirakawa-go Bus Terminal). Note: APA has no branch in Takayama, so Wat Hotel & Spa offers the same convenient station proximity + rooftop natural onsen. Dinner: Hidagyu Maruaki (Tabelog ★3.69).

timeSlots.desc: Hokutetsu/Nohi Express Bus into snow-covered Shirakawa-go; store bags at terminal
Walk Gassho-zukuri thatched farmhouses, Shiroyama snowy viewpoint & hearth irori tofu lunch (★3.52)
Highway bus south to Takayama Nohi Bus Center & check into Wat Hotel & Spa Hida Takayama
Butcher-direct A5 Hida Wagyu grill & Hoba Miso dinner at Hidagyu Maruaki (Tabelog ★3.69)

days.routeJp: Takayama ↔ Shinhotaka Ropeway (2,156m Winter Snow Alps) & Sanmachi Old Town
days.routeEn: Ascend Japan's only double-decker gondola into 2,156m alpine winter peaks, plus Hirayu Onsen & Takayama ramen
legs: Takayama ↔ Shinhotaka Ropeway via Hirayu Onsen (Nohi Bus 2-Day Open Pass ¥4,400 • Non-JR)
days.tip: Shinhotaka Ropeway Round-Trip (¥3,800 in Dining/Activities budget) climbs to 2,156m Nishihotakaguchi snow deck. Back in town by 15:30 for Sanmachi Old Town & soy-bonito ramen at Menya Shirakawa (Tabelog ★3.74).

timeSlots.desc: Nohi Bus scenic mountain ride past Hirayu Onsen up to Shinhotaka Ropeway base
Double-decker alpine gondola, Northern Alps 360° snow peaks & snow wall walk
Return to Takayama for historic merchant streets, Takayama Jinya & Chuka Soba dinner (★3.74)

days.routeJp: Takayama → Matsumoto Castle Snow Alps → JR to Takasaki (Gunma APA)
days.routeEn: Direct trans-mountain bus via Abo Tunnel straight to snowy Matsumoto Castle, ★3.72 soba & Takasaki natural onsen base
legs: Takayama → Matsumoto Bus Terminal (Alpico/Nohi Bus ¥4,400 • Non-JR)
Matsumoto → Nagano (JR Shinano Ltd Exp ¥2,370)
Nagano → Takasaki (Hokuriku Shinkansen ¥4,950)
days.tip: Lunch at Matsumoto soba gem Nomugi (Tabelog ★3.72 — arrive before 12:30 as handmade kyuwari-soba sells out early!). APA Hotel Takasaki Ekimae connects directly to JR Takasaki Station & has natural hot spring baths.

timeSlots.desc: Stroll Takayama Miyagawa Morning Market, then 07:50 Alpico/Nohi Bus through Northern Alps to Matsumoto
Store luggage at Matsumoto Stn; photograph Black Crow Castle against snow peaks + Nomugi soba lunch (★3.72) & Nawate Street
JR Shinano to Nagano + Hokuriku Shinkansen to Takasaki & check in APA Hotel Takasaki Ekimae (Gunma Torimeshi dinner ★3.54)

days.routeJp: Takasaki ↔ Kusatsu Onsen Snow Town (Yubatake, Yumomi & Sainokawara Bath)
days.routeEn: Easy JR Agatsuma Line + JR Bus up to steaming volcanic sulfur spring conduits in snow & top-rated stone-milled soba
legs: Takasaki ↔ Naganoharakusatsuguchi (JR Agatsuma Line ¥2,460 RT)
Naganoharakusatsuguchi ↔ Kusatsu Onsen Bus Terminal (JR Bus Kanto ¥1,560 RT • Non-JR)
days.tip: Lunch at Ishiusubiki Soba Mikuniya (2 min from Yubatake, Tabelog ★3.49), enjoy warm steamed Matsumura Manju (★3.58), watch Netsunoyu Yumomi dance & soak in open-air Sainokawara Rotenburo surrounded by snow.

timeSlots.desc: JR Agatsuma Line mountain train + seamless JR Bus transfer up into snowy Kusatsu
Steaming Yubatake sulfur field, Netsunoyu Yumomi stirring show & stone-milled soba at Mikuniya (★3.49)
Huge open-air Sainokawara snow hot spring soak, Yubatake dusk lights & return to Takasaki APA

days.routeJp: Takasaki → Tokyo (Shinkansen): Meiji Jingu, Harajuku, Omotesando & Nakameguro
days.routeEn: 50-min bullet train back to Tokyo Day 4! Forested Meiji Jingu Shrine, Harajuku/Omotesando shopping & craft ramen
days.hotel: APA Hotel & Resort Nishishinjuku Gochome Eki Tower
legs: Takasaki → Tokyo (Joetsu/Hokuriku Shinkansen ¥4,990)
Tokyo Metro / Yamanote Line (¥510)
days.tip: APA Nishishinjuku Gochome Eki Tower has an expansive outdoor/indoor onsen bath right beside Oedo Line. Try Ginza Hachigou or Shinjuku Fuunji ramen (Tabelog ★3.86) or Tonkatsu Maisen Omotesando (★3.68).

timeSlots.desc: Morning Shinkansen Takasaki → Tokyo; hop Oedo Line to APA Nishishinjuku Gochome to drop bags
Meiji Jingu Shrine, Yoyogi Park plum blossoms, Omotesando architecture & Tonkatsu Maisen (★3.68)
Shibuya / Nakameguro evening stroll & Shinjuku Fuunji tsukemen dinner (★3.86)

days.routeJp: Tokyo Day 5 (Sun): Toyosu Market Sushi, Ginza, Akihabara & Farewell Feast
days.routeEn: Fresh Toyosu morning sushi (Sushi Dai / Daiwa ★3.78), Imperial East Gardens plum/sakura & Ginza/Akihabara Sunday pedestrian paradise
days.hotel: APA Hotel & Resort Nishishinjuku Gochome Eki Tower
legs: Tokyo Metro / Yurikamome / JR Loop (¥900)
days.tip: Sundays turn Ginza Chuo-dori into a pedestrian promenade (Hokosha Tengoku). Enjoy Toyosu Market Edomae sushi (Tabelog ★3.78) in the morning and tax-free Ginza/Tokyo Station shopping in the afternoon!

timeSlots.desc: Early sushi breakfast at Toyosu Market / Tsukiji Outer Market (Tabelog ★3.78)
Imperial Palace East Gardens winter plum blossoms + Ginza Sunday pedestrian avenue
Akihabara electronics/pop-culture browsing & farewell Tokyo Station ramen street / Ginza Hachigou (★3.86)

days.routeJp: Tokyo Last Morning Shopping → Haneda / Narita Airport (HND / NRT) Departure
days.routeEn: Check out at 10:00, final Tokyo Station souvenir sweets & seamless express train to airport
legs: Tokyo / Shinjuku → Narita Express or Haneda Monorail (¥3,070 + Return Flight ¥45,000 est.)
days.tip: Tab 5 Pass Audit: Across this 16-day multi-company corridor (Fujikyu, Izukyu, Nohi Bus, Alpico Bus, Thunderbird/Shinkansen), total JR fares (~¥45k–¥49k) sit far below the 14-day Nationwide JR Pass (¥80,000), so paying point-to-point + the ¥6,500 Hokuriku One-Way Ticket saves >¥30,000!

timeSlots.desc: Check out & pick up final packaged omiyage sweets inside JR Tokyo Station
Airport express train transfer & international flight home

hotels.name: APA Hotel & Resort Shinjuku Kabukicho Tower
hotels.access: 6-min walk from JR Shinjuku Station East/West Exits & Seibu Shinjuku Stn
hotels.highlights: Ideal West-Tokyo APA base with top-floor public bath & easy walking access to Shinjuku Fuji Excursion / Busta Shinjuku.

hotels.name: APA Hotel Shizuoka-eki Kita
hotels.access: 5-min walk from JR Shizuoka Station North Exit
hotels.highlights: High-value Shizuoka hub just 28 min by JR Tokaido Line from Fujikawa Stn (EXPASA Starbucks) & direct Shinkansen to Kyoto.

hotels.name: APA Hotel Kyoto Ekimae
hotels.access: 3-min walk from JR Kyoto Station Central Exit
hotels.highlights: Weekend Kyoto base steps from Shinkansen, JR Inari/Arashiyama lines & City Bus hub.

hotels.name: APA Hotel Kanazawa Ekimae
hotels.access: 1-min walk from JR Kanazawa Station West Exit
hotels.highlights: Flagship hotel in APA's founding city featuring natural spa baths & instant access to Shirakawa-go bus terminal.

hotels.name: Wat Hotel & Spa Hida Takayama (Closest APA-Tier Onsen Hotel)
hotels.access: 7-min walk from JR Takayama & Nohi Bus Center
hotels.highlights: APA operates no branch in Takayama proper; Wat Hotel & Spa mirrors APA's compact station-front convenience with rooftop hot springs for Shinhotaka & Shirakawa-go.

hotels.name: APA Hotel Takasaki Ekimae
hotels.access: Directly connected to JR Takasaki Station West Exit (pedestrian deck)
hotels.highlights: Zero-hassle Gunma rail hub with natural hot spring bath & morning JR Agatsuma Line access to snowy Kusatsu Onsen.

hotels.name: APA Hotel & Resort Nishishinjuku Gochome Eki Tower
hotels.access: 1-min walk from Toei Oedo Nishishinjuku-gochome Stn (4 min to Shinjuku)
hotels.highlights: Spacious large-bath APA Tower for your final two nights in West Tokyo before airport departure.

food.dish: Ginza / Shinjuku Top Tsukemen & Shoyu Ramen
food.place: Rokurinsha / Ramen Hayashi / Chukasoba Tomita (KITTE)
food.transitText: 🟢 Tokyo Station Ramen Street / KITTE / Shinjuku

food.dish: Asakusa / Nihonbashi Tempura & Tendon
food.place: Kaneko Hannosuke Nihonbashi / Daikokuya Asakusa
food.transitText: 🟢 2-min walk Mitsukoshimae / Asakusa Stn

food.dish: Toyosu Morning Market & Standing Edomae Sushi
food.place: Sushi Dai (Toyosu) / Nemuro Hanamaru Ginza
food.transitText: 🟢 Yurikamome Shijomae Stn / Tokyo Metro Ginza
food.note: Seasoned red-vinegar akazu shari topped with Toyosu dawn-auctioned otoro, sweet shrimp & kohada.

food.dish: Tsukiji Outer Market Tamagoyaki & Wagyu Skewers
food.place: Tsukiji Outer Market (Yamacho / Shouro / Kitsuneya)
food.transitText: 🟢 3-min walk Hibiya Line Tsukiji Stn
food.note: Piping hot sweet dashi rolled omelets on sticks, grilled scallops & savory hormone-don bowls along vibrant dawn lanes.

food.dish: Tamura Ginkatsu-tei Tofu Katsuni
food.place: Tamura Ginkatsu-tei (Gora Stn)
food.transitText: 🟢 2-min walk Hakone Tozan Gora Stn
food.note: Hand-crisp tofu stuffed with juicy seasoned minced pork simmered bubbling in savory sweet-soy egg dashi.

food.dish: Gora Bakery & Ashinoko Wood-Fired Pizza / Soba
food.place: Bakery & Table Hakone / La Terrazza Ashinoko / Hatsu-hana
food.transitText: 🟡 Motohakone Pier / Hakone-Yumoto Walkable
food.note: Whole curry-boiled-egg buns dipped at waterfront footbaths overlooking Lake Ashi torii & Hakone-Yumoto mountain-yam soba.

food.dish: Owakudani Kuro-Tamago (Black Volcanic Sulfuric Eggs)
food.place: Owakudani Kuro-Tamago Kan
food.transitText: 🟡 Hakone Ropeway Owakudani Stn
food.note: Sulfur-steamed obsidian shells yielding warm moist eggs said to add 7 years per egg.

food.dish: Atami Purin Caramel Custard & Kinmedai Golden-Eye Snapper
food.place: Atami Purin 1st Shop / Tokuichi / Osaikana Shokudo
food.transitText: 🟢 3-min walk JR Atami Stn (Nakamise / Ginza)
food.note: Silky hippo-bottled sea-salt & caramel puddings plus overflowing Sagami Bay chopped-seafood bowls & simmered Kinmedai.

food.dish: Atami Bonito Ramen & Fresh Fried Fishcake Skewers
food.place: Ume-hachi / Maruten Atami / Amai-dokoro Cafe
food.transitText: 🟢 Nakamise & Heiwa-dori Covered Arcades
food.note: Sizzling hot seafood fishcakes stuffed with octopus & cheese-butter along steaming station shopping alleys.

food.dish: MOA Museum of Art Patisserie & Classic Seafood Kaiseki
food.place: La Patisserie du Musee by Toshi Yoroizuka / Watahan
food.transitText: 🟡 7-min Tokai Bus from JR Atami Stn to MOA
food.note: Michelin chef Toshi Yoroizuka desserts overlooking panoramic Pacific Island Hatsushima & Sagami Bay.

food.dish: Inatori / Shimoda Kinmedai (Whole Simmered Splendid Alfonsino)
food.place: Tokuzo Honten (Inatori) / Kinme-dokoro Nakaya
food.transitText: 🟢 Near Izu-Inatori / Izukyu-Shimoda Stn
food.note: Sweet-soy lacquered crimson Kinmedai snapper poached whole with ginger—an unforgettable eastern Izu feast.

food.dish: Kawazu Wasabi Don & Izu Kanzan Shuzenji Soba
food.place: Kadoya (Kawazu Nanadaru) / Zenpukuji Soba (Shuzenji)
food.transitText: 🟡 Tokai Bus to Kawazu Seven Falls / Shuzenji Onsen
food.note: Grate raw Amagi mountain wasabi straight onto warm katsuobushi bonito rice at Kawazu's viral wooden shop!

food.dish: Kawazu-zakura Taiyaki & Ito/Izu-Kogen Ocean Cafe
food.place: Cafe Blossom / Fish Don-ya / Omuroyama Matcha
food.transitText: 🟢 Jogasaki Coast / Omuroyama Chairlift
food.note: Mount Komuroyama ocean terrace lattes & Jogasaki suspension-bridge cliffside seafood grilled over charcoal.

food.dish: Sawayaka 100% Charcoal Hamburg Steak (Censured Only in Shizuoka!)
food.place: Charcoal Restaurant Sawayaka (Shin-Shizuoka Cenova)
food.transitText: 🟢 新静岡セノバ 5F (9-min walk JR Shizuoka Stn)
food.note: Japan's ultimate prefecture-exclusive cult steakhouse—juicy rare-center 250g beef seared tableside with onion sauce!

food.dish: Shizuoka Kuro Oden (Aoba Yokocho Dark-Broth Stew)
food.place: Oden-ya Obachan / Aoba Oden Yokocho / Ogasawara
food.transitText: 🟢 8-min walk JR Shizuoka Stn (Aoba Yokocho)
food.note: Bamboo-skewered black fishcake kuro-hanpen & beef tendon simmered in rich dark broth, dusted with dashi-nori fish powder!

food.dish: Nanaya World's Richest Matcha No.7 Gelato & Sakura Shrimp
food.place: Nanaya Shizuoka / Maguro & Sakura-ebi Don (Shimizu)
food.transitText: 🟢 10-min walk JR Shizuoka Stn / Shimizu Stn
food.note: Compare 7 intensities of Fujieda matcha gelato up to intense Level 7, plus fresh Suruga Bay sakura shrimp & Shimizu tuna!

food.dish: Kichi Kichi & Kyoto Obanzai / Yudofu (Nanzenji)
food.place: Junsei (Nanzenji) / Okutan Kiyomizu / Roan Kikunoi
food.transitText: 🟢 5-min walk Subway Keage Stn (Nanzenji)
food.note: Simmering silk tofu set inside Meiji-era landscaped pond gardens flanking Nanzenji's brick aqueduct.

food.dish: Uji Nakamura Tokichi Matcha Parfait & Hojicha Jelly
food.place: Nakamura Tokichi Kyoto Stn / Gion Tsujiri / Saryo
food.transitText: 🟢 JR Kyoto Station West 2F / Gion Shijo
food.note: Emerald bamboo-bowl matcha jellies layered over dense stone-milled Uji ice cream, chestnut & soft shiratama.

food.dish: Gion Pork Tonkatsu / Menbaka Fire Ramen & Kyoto Ramen
food.place: Katsukura Sanjo / Shinpuku Saikan / Honke Daiichi Asahi
food.transitText: 🟢 5-min walk JR Kyoto Stn Central East / Sanjo
food.note: Dawn-until-night clear golden Kyoto pork-shoyu ramen laden with crisp Kujo scallions beside crisp Katsukura tonkatsu.

food.dish: Nishiki Market Matcha Mochi, Tako-Tamago & Fresh Yuba
food.place: Nishiki Market (Miki Keiran / Tanakake / Kai)
food.transitText: 🟢 3-min walk Subway Shijo / Hankyu Karasuma
food.note: 5-block covered market glowing with fluffy dashi tamagoyaki, soy-glazed baby octopus & sizzling fresh-grated chestnut mont blanc.

food.dish: Omicho Market Gold-Leaf Kaisen-don & Nodoguro
food.place: Ikiiki-tei / Mori Mori Sushi (Omicho & Forus)
food.transitText: 🟢 12-min walk or 5-min bus JR Kanazawa Stn
food.note: Sea of Japan winter blackthroat seaperch seared creamy over warm rice alongside sweet gas-shrimp & snow crab.

food.dish: Hakuichi 24K Gold-Leaf Soft Cream & Higashi Chaya Sweets
food.place: Hakuichi Higashiyama / Sabo Soshin / Kazu-e-machi
food.transitText: 🟢 Higashi Chaya Geisha District (JR Bus 10m)

days.routeJp: 東京到着（羽田/成田）→ アパホテル新宿歌舞伎町タワー＆思い出横丁
days.routeEn: 空港アクセスで新宿へ移動。交通系ICカード準備後、都庁無料夜景展望＆新宿ディナー
days.hotel: アパホテル＆リゾート〈西新宿・新宿歌舞伎町タワー〉
legs: 東京行き航空券（目安 ¥45,000）
羽田空港 / 成田空港 → JR新宿駅（¥1,500）
days.tip: 到着前にモバイルSuica準備が便利。大浴場完備の新宿アパホテルで初日の移動疲れを癒せます。

timeSlots.desc: モノレール・京急・JR乗り継ぎで新宿駅へ移動
アパホテル〈新宿 歌舞伎町タワー〉チェックイン
東京都庁展望室から無料夜景鑑賞＆新宿思い出横丁で初日ディナー

days.routeJp: 東京 ↔ 河口湖日帰り（大石公園・パノラマロープウェイ・ほうとう不動）
days.routeEn: 翌2/23(祝・天皇誕生日)の混雑を避けた月曜日に訪問！雪化粧の富士山＆ほうとうランチ
days.hotel: アパホテル＆リゾート〈西新宿・新宿歌舞伎町タワー〉
legs: 新宿 ↔ 大月（JR特急富士回遊 往復 ¥4,400）
大月 ↔ 河口湖（富士急行線 往復 ¥3,860 • JR以外）
河口湖周遊バス レッドライン1日券（¥1,500 • JR以外）
days.tip: 特急「富士回遊」は1ヶ月前10時に要予約（満席時はバスタ新宿発高速バス往復¥4,400も快適）。河口湖駅前の「ほうとう不動（食べログ★3.57）」が定番。

timeSlots.desc: JR直通特急「富士回遊」で河口湖駅へ
周遊バスで大石公園の富士山撮影＆富士山パノラマロープウェイ
名物かぼちゃ味噌ほうとう（ほうとう不動 • 食べログ★3.57）ランチ
夕方の富士回遊で新宿アパホテルへ帰着

days.routeJp: 東京満喫（祝）：浅草寺・上野公園の梅と寒桜・銀座＆渋谷スカイ夕景
days.routeEn: 天皇誕生日の祝日は都内周遊！上野の梅と早咲き寒桜を愛でた後、渋谷スカイへ
days.hotel: アパホテル＆リゾート〈西新宿・新宿歌舞伎町タワー〉
legs: 東京メトロ24時間券・都内JR移動（¥900）
days.tip: 渋谷スカイの16:40夕暮れ枠は4週間前に要予約。浅草で老舗うなぎ（色川・初小川 ★3.72）もおすすめ。

timeSlots.desc: 朝の浅草寺・仲見世通り＆隅田公園散策
浅草老舗うなぎランチ（★3.72）後、上野公園の梅・寒桜鑑賞
渋谷スカイ展望台から富士山のシルエットと東京夕景・夜景鑑賞

days.routeJp: 東京 → 熱海梅園＆河津桜まつり（満開の早咲き桜）→ 静岡アパホテル泊
days.routeEn: 大きな荷物は京都へ宅配便！熱海梅園と河津川沿い約850本の濃いピンクの河津桜を1日で満喫
legs: 東京 → 熱海 → 河津 → 熱海 → 静岡（JR特急踊り子・伊東線 ¥7,400 ＋ 伊豆急行線 ¥3,420 • JR以外）
days.tip: 大荷物は新宿アパから京都アパへ宅急便（約¥2,200）し、熱海駅コインロッカー利用で身軽に！昼食は熱海銀座おさかな食堂（★3.50）が人気。

timeSlots.desc: 熱海到着後コインロッカーに荷物を預け、バスで熱海梅園へ
熱海梅園梅まつり散策＆熱海銀座おさかな食堂（食べログ★3.50）で海鮮ランチ
伊豆急行・踊り子で河津へ！満開の河津桜川沿い遊歩道＆わさび丼散策
熱海乗換・JR東海道線で静岡駅へ移動しアパホテル静岡駅北チェックイン

days.routeJp: 静岡 ↔ 富士川SAスタバ（朝の富士山絶景カフェ）・日本平＆三保松原・静岡おでん
days.routeEn: 雲の出にくい朝7時台にJR富士川駅＋タクシーでEXPASA富士川スタバへ！午後は日本平・三保松原、夜は静岡おでん
legs: 静岡 ↔ 富士川 ↔ 清水（JR東海道線 ¥1,440）
富士川駅 → 富士川楽座/SA 往路早朝タクシー（¥1,200 絶景優先）＋復路バス（¥200）
日本平・三保松原バス移動（¥1,200 • JR以外）
days.tip: 静岡泊だからこそ朝7時前に出発して富士川駅＋タクシー約5分で晴天率最高の富士川SAスタバ（絶景テラス）へ直行可能！帰りは富士川楽座前の路線バス利用可。夜は青葉横丁の静岡おでん（食べログ★3.56）。

timeSlots.desc: JR富士川駅着後タクシー5分でEXPASA富士川へ。朝の晴天時に富士山一望のスタバ絶景タイム（帰りはバス利用）
日本平夢テラス・久能山ロープウェイ＆世界遺産・三保の松原から富士山遠望
青葉横丁・青葉おでん街で静岡おでん＆黒はんぺん夕食（食べログ★3.56）

days.routeJp: 静岡 → 東海道新幹線「ひかり」で京都へ＆夕暮れの伏見稲荷大社・千本鳥居
days.routeEn: 新幹線で京都駅へ直通！APA京都駅前チェックイン後、混雑の落ち着いた夕方の伏見稲荷へ
legs: 静岡 → 京都（東海道新幹線ひかり ¥10,450）
京都 ↔ 稲荷（JR奈良線 往復 ¥300）
days.tip: 新宿から送った大型荷物をアパホテル京都駅前で受取。夕方はJR奈良線5分の伏見稲荷へ。夕食は京都駅ビル「名代とんかつ かつくら（★3.64）」。

timeSlots.desc: 東海道新幹線ひかりで京都駅へ直通移動
宅急便荷物の受取＆アパホテル京都駅前周辺ランチ散策
夕方の伏見稲荷大社・千本鳥居参拝後、名代とんかつ「かつくら（★3.64）」夕食

days.routeJp: 京都週末1日目(土)：清水寺・二年坂・北野天満宮「梅苑」＆祇園・先斗町
days.routeEn: 早朝の清水寺・産寧坂から錦市場食べ歩き、さらに2月下旬満開の北野天満宮梅苑＆夜の祇園花見小路
legs: 京都市地下鉄・バス1日券（¥1,100 • JR以外）
days.tip: 2月最終週末の北野天満宮「梅苑」は1,500本が満開の見頃！昼は錦市場、夕暮れは石塀小路・祇園散策。

timeSlots.desc: 開門直後の清水寺〜産寧坂・二年坂〜八坂神社を静かな時間帯に散策
京の台所・錦市場でおばんざいや生湯葉グルメ食べ歩き
市バスで北野天満宮へ。見頃の紅白1,500本の梅苑鑑賞＆梅茶屋一服
先斗町・花見小路の京情緒ある夜散歩＆祇園ダックヌードル等（★3.70）

days.routeJp: 京都週末2日目(日)：早朝の嵐山竹林・渡月橋・湯豆腐＆金閣寺・宇治抹茶パフェ
days.routeEn: 日曜朝の混雑前にJR嵯峨野線で嵐山竹林＆天龍寺へ！嵐山湯豆腐ランチと午後の金閣寺・京都駅抹茶スイーツ
legs: 京都 ↔ 嵯峨嵐山（JR嵯峨野線 ¥480）
嵐山 → 金閣寺 → 京都駅（嵐電＆京都市バス ¥700 • JR以外）
days.tip: ランチは名水仕込みの湯豆腐（嵐山嵯峨野 ★3.68）、夕方京都駅で中村藤吉本店（★3.75）の抹茶パフェ。

timeSlots.desc: JR嵯峨野線16分で朝イチの嵐山竹林の小径・天龍寺・渡月橋をゆったり鑑賞
京都名物 伝統湯豆腐コースランチ（食べログ★3.68）
嵐電＆バスで金閣寺（鹿苑寺）拝観後、京都駅伊勢丹3F・中村藤吉本店（★3.75）で抹茶パフェ

days.routeJp: 京都 → 金沢（サンダーバード＋北陸新幹線）・兼六園の雪吊り＆近江町市場海鮮
days.routeEn: APA発祥の金沢へ！敦賀経由で北陸新幹線乗継。冬の加能ガニ・のどぐろ丼、兼六園の雪吊り、ひがし茶屋街

金沢周遊バス1日券（¥800 • JR以外）

アパホテル金沢駅前に荷物預け後、近江町市場で冬の香箱・加能ガニ＆のどぐろ海鮮丼（★3.64）
冬名物「雪吊り」の兼六園・金沢城公園＆ひがし茶屋街で金箔ソフト＆金沢おでん夕食（★3.71）
